author: opencode-worker-3
text: REFINED IMPLEMENTATION BLUEPRINT (worker-3, scoped this round — 60-90 min total, does not fit a timebox; release before starting): (1) API: lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao/_ex change 'bool origin_authenticated' -> 'const uint8_t origin_pubkey[32]' (nullable; NULL = provenance unverified). CONFIRMED: origin_authenticated is currently DEAD plumbing — process_dao never reads it (rpl_dao_process.c:891/907 accept, never use). (2) Verification in process_dao (it owns the option framing): the 0x12 branch already enforces final-option/length; capture seq = opt data[0..8] BE, sig = data[8..56], unsigned span = dao_bytes[0 .. option_type_pos], effective DODAGID = dm->dodag_id (both D=1-explicit and D=0 must equal it per :787). After the walk: if origin_pubkey != NULL -> transcript per spec 05 8.6 = SHA-512('LICHEN-DAO-ORIGIN-v1' (20 ASCII, no NUL) || origin(16) || dodagid(16) || seq(8) || unsigned span); schnorr48_verify(pubkey, digest64, 64, sig, 48); authenticated = verified. NULL pubkey -> authenticated=false (DAO rejected? — decide: spec says provenance MUST verify; unverified -> reject). (3) Crypto deps: mirror sos_origin.c (crypto_sha512_ctx incremental, monocypher) + schnorr48.h; add schnorr48.c+monocypher.c+monocypher-ed25519.c to rpl_dao_auth/rpl_routing host CMakeLists (they currently link no crypto). (4) TEST SURFACE (the bulk): rpl_routing has ~15 _ex call sites passing literal 'true' with add_origin_signature's dummy 0x5a bytes — each needs a real signature (a test signing key + transcript recompute per case) OR the tests pass NULL pubkey with expectations downgraded to REJECTED where the DAO should not apply... simplest: add a test-local schnorr48 keypair + a make_origin_signature(dao,len,key) helper computing the real transcript signature; replace all dummy sites. (5) Pin-source: the pubkey param comes from lichen_announce_get_pinned_pubkey (zlbs, landed) at the gateway boundary.
